entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line to speak with a representative.
(Muttering) One... just get me a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I expected. The order number is VF58291.

I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see you here, Mr. Davies. I'm showing the VeloBand Pulse was delivered about 15 days ago. And I see you're a VIP member with us, thank you for your loyalty.
Right. So how do I send this thing back?
Absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return window, so we can get that processed right away. I can email a pre-paid return label to you immediately.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. Perfect. Yes, please send the label.

One moment while I generate that... actually, Mr. Davies, I need to correct myself. My apologies, I was looking at the policy for our stationary bikes. The VeloBand accessories actually have a 14-day return window.
Wait, what? Are you serious? But **you just said** it was 90 days. I'm one day over a two-week policy? That's ridiculous.
I completely understand your frustration, sir, and I sincerely apologize for misspeaking. The standard policy for our wearable tech is 14 days from delivery.

No, no. You **promised me** I was 'well within' the window. This is a **recorded line**, isn't it? This feels like a total **bait and switch**. You tell me it's fine, and then as soon as I agree, you change the story?

Sir, it was a genuine mistake on my part, and I'm very sorry for the confusion it's caused. Please, allow me to see what I can do. As you are a valued VIP member, let me see if I can get an exception approved for you.
You'd better. This is unbelievable.

Please hold for just one moment... (pause) ... Okay, Mr. Davies, thank you for your patience. I've spoken with my manager, and given my error and your long history with VeloFit, we are absolutely going to honor the return for you. I have personally overridden the system and am sending that pre-paid return label to your email now.
So it's a full refund? No restocking fees or any of that nonsense?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method as soon as the item is received at our warehouse. For the trouble I've caused, I've also added a $25 store credit to your VeloFit account.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... that's the right thing to do. Thank you. I appreciate you fixing that.
Of course, Mr. Davies. It was my pleasure to resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
